submittedPrompt: 绘制中文网页局部状态对照板，白底浅灰面、蓝色主动作、细线小圆角、紧凑清晰。各行独立、留白细线分隔，只画指定组件，不画主人导航、浏览器边框或审查元信息。五个独立局部行。1 完整权限片段：“知识库”卡片开关开启，“知识库能力预设”选“只读”，“知识库资源范围”选“整个知识库”，灰色说明“目录授权跟随身份并覆盖后代；自主整理允许直接创建、移动和改名。归档和维护索引独立设置。”，折叠“独立权限与高级选项”。下方勾选框“保持连接，允许刷新访问令牌”勾选；不出现全局重绑动作。2 独立提交中片段：灰色禁用的“知识库能力预设”下拉只读、灰色禁用且勾选的“保持连接，允许刷新访问令牌”；底部“拒绝”禁用、“允许访问”转圈禁用。3 兼容授权操作片段，标题“允许的操作”，复选框“读取所选目录中的资料”勾选、“创建、修改和归档资料”未勾选、“保持连接，允许刷新访问令牌”勾选。4 兼容授权目录片段“允许的资料目录”，目录复选框00-Inbox勾选、30-Knowledge未勾选。5 另一兼容片段：读取所选目录中的资料勾选，目录00-Inbox和30-Knowledge都未勾选，“拒绝”可用、“允许访问”灰色禁用。所有分区相互独立，不能混同兼容复选框与新权限卡，不加搜索、创建、密码、登录或其他按钮。

sourceContracts.title: OAuth 连接授权：业务与资源策略

entry.trigger: Signed-in owner; ready platform; onboarding complete

permissionRules: Owner session required; signed OAuth query <=16384 characters; exactly one client_id; resource must equal installation origin+/mcp; client must exist and be enabled.
Requested scopes intersect server policy and owner resource ceilings. ToDoo write requires read; v2 blog publish requires knowledge read.

fields.name: permissionPolicy
fields.constraints: subset of server allowedPolicy; shared MCPDomainPermissions

fields.name: offline_access
fields.constraints: shown only when requested and allowed

importantStates: invalid selection disables allow; busy locks controls
submitted consent redirects to validated result

responsive.supported: Source-defined responsive layout; not runtime-verified in this read-only inventory
responsive.behavior: Max 640px; <=600px reduces padding, wraps scope text and gives actions equal flexible widths (OAuthConsent.vue:339). Runtime unverified.

sourceContracts.designReason: A concrete page with its own content, action hierarchy and business state; include in the GPT Image 2 review queue before implementation.
notes: Consent can mention ToDoo permissions because it authorizes a connection; ToDoo product UI is out of scope. Shared MCPDomainPermissions editor details belong to settings inventory.

sourceContracts.title: OAuth 连接授权：兼容目录与操作列表
permissionRules: Owner session and ready, completed onboarding required. Signed client request and server policy ceiling remain authoritative.

fields.name: scopes
fields.constraints: must include resource scope; allowedScopes subset

fields.name: allowedPrefixes
fields.constraints: required when selected knowledge scope or blog:publish; subset of allowed prefixes

actions.label: 允许访问
actions.guard: ToDoo write=>read; blog publish=>knowledge read+write; required directories selected

importantStates: directory choices shown for knowledge scope or blog publish
